title: Secret Management
description: Manage your key-value credentials (GitHub token / password / API key, etc.). Each key becomes an environment variable that can be injected into the container during training (values are never written into the config in plain text; they go through secretKeyRef). A value is no longer shown after it is saved, and it belongs only to you.

columns.key: Key (= environment variable name injected during training)

deleteDesc: After deletion, the environment variables of training jobs that reference it stop working.
howDesc: When creating a training job, click "Add environment variable from Secret" in the environment variables section, pick a key, and it is injected as an environment variable of the main container (the variable name defaults to the key name). Configs and shares contain only the reference, never the plain-text value.

form.keyExtra: A key with the same name is overwritten (= updated), e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN.
